title: Project Cygnus / Astraea
subtitle: Astraea · repository
headline: Research records from an astronomical data-forensics project
tagline: Cygnus re-examines public archive data for signals that survey pipelines may have discarded, and records every test that could show a signal is an artifact. This site publishes the parts of that work the operator has chosen to release.
footer_note: A public, curated view of a private research worktree. External archive products are linked to their source archives, not re-hosted.
